d.name: BioShock® 2
d.desc: Set approximately 10 years after the events of the original BioShock, the halls of Rapture once again echo with sins of the past. Along the Atlantic coastline, a monster has been snatching little girls and bringing them back to the undersea city of Rapture.

NVIDIA 7800GT 256MB graphics card or better, ATI Radeon X1900 256MB graphics card or better
100% DirectX 9.0C compliant sound card or onboard sound

d.blurb:
Roughly ten years after the first game, this sequel returns to Rapture, the city beneath the Atlantic. You play a Big Daddy, one of the city's armored guardians, moving through its decaying halls to learn who is taking little girls from the coast and bringing them below. As a first-person shooter, it combines conventional weapons with Plasmid powers and tonics.

A separate multiplayer mode works as a prequel set during Rapture's fall, casting you as a test subject for Plasmids at Sinclair Solutions. The single-player campaign carries a moody atmosphere and a story about the city's past. It suits players who enjoyed the setting of the original, and full controller support is included for those who prefer a pad.
